queries_run: Arm Holdings customer concentration risk Arm China Qualcomm 2026

findings.claim: FY2026（截至2026-03-31）前五大客戶（含 Arm China、SoftBank）合計約占營收57%（FY25 56%、FY24 54%）；最大客戶 Arm China 約16%（FY25 17%、FY24 21%）；部分近期營收依賴與 SoftBank 的商業安排。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 20-F FY2026 Item 3 風險因子
findings.excerpt: our top five customers (including Arm China and SoftBank Group) collectively accounted for approximately 57%, 56% and 54% of our total revenue for the fiscal years ended March 31, 2026, 2025 and 2024, respectively, and our largest customer individually, Arm China, accounted for approximately 16%, 17% and 21% of our total revenue, respectively, during those fiscal years.

findings.claim: FY2026 有三家客戶合計占營收42%（16%／14%／12%）；FY2025 為四家合計49%。應收帳款最大客戶占22%；信用損失歷年不重大。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 20-F FY2026 Item 8 信用風險集中
findings.excerpt: For the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026, the Company had three customers that collectively represented 42% of total revenue, with the single largest customer accounting for 16% of total revenue, the second largest customer accounting for 14% of total revenue, and the third largest customer accounting for 12% of total revenue.

findings.claim: Qualcomm 為主要客戶，占 FY2026 營收9%，且與 Arm 有訴訟。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 20-F FY2026 Item 3 風險因子
findings.excerpt: Qualcomm, which is currently a major customer of ours and accounted for 9% of our total revenue for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026.

findings.claim: S&P 2026-03 將 SoftBank 展望由穩定降為負面、維持 BB+，因加碼 OpenAI；Arm 持股為其評等支撐。
findings.source: pulse.bot Finance News: SoftBank's $30 Billion OpenAI Bet Spurs S&P Credit Outlook Cut

findings.claim: Barron's：SoftBank 持有 Arm 約90%，為設計授權業務基石客戶，9月當季占設計授權業務35%。
findings.source: Barron's: Arm Stock Is Falling. Its Biggest Customer Might Be Masking Larger Problems

note: SoftBank 信用：搜尋摘要稱 2026-03 S&P 將 SoftBank 展望由穩定降為負面、維持 BB+（因加碼 OpenAI 300億美元），後續（2026-08 報導）展望回到穩定；未找到 2026 年實際評等調降的來源，且摘要彼此時間點有衝突，僅列線索。 線索 2 條，程式核實 0 條，2 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
